teachingReview.heading: Use the current label
teachingReview.body: Treatment and post-exposure prophylaxis begin at age 5. Tablets use 40 mg once from 20 to less than 80 kg and 80 mg once at 80 kg or more. Current RxPrep age-12 language is outdated.

teachingReview.heading: Avoid chelation

teachingReview.body: The book gives reconstituted oseltamivir suspension 10 days at room temperature or 17 days refrigerated. teachingReview.heading: Inhibit pUL97 directly
teachingReview.body: Maribavir is a benzimidazole riboside that inhibits pUL97 kinase, disrupting viral DNA replication, encapsidation, and nuclear egress. This is distinct from ganciclovir, which needs pUL97 for activation.
